title: Run every Output Job medium of the focused project
summary: Walks the media of the focused project's Output Jobs and launches WorkspaceManager:GenerateReport or WorkspaceManager:Print for each with DXP.Utils.RunCommand, reporting the files written; shows the real TypeString values and which launch route actually generates.
phrasings: run an output job from an extension
publish an output container to PDF
list the output media of an OutJob

commands.name: RunOutputJobs
commands.description: For every OutJob of the focused project: open and show it, then launch the process of each output medium whose TypeString is in Types (and whose name is Medium, if given); report the launched processes with their parameter strings and the files written under Out
commands.params: Out=<folder> (default <temp>\OutputJobGenerate)|Types=Generate Files (';'-separated TypeString values; 'Print' and 'PDF' are opt-in)|Medium=<medium name>|Route=RunCommand|MessageRouter|Launcher|EditProperties=False

commands.name: ListOutputMedia
commands.description: List the OutJobs of the focused project and each output medium's Name, TypeString and OutputPath
